# Native Land & Resource Conservancy (NLRC)

> NLRC is an engineering-led land origination company that identifies, diligences and advances powered land (also called power-enabled land) for data center developers and AI infrastructure, in partnership with landowners. Data center developers can connect directly with Brian Beauchamp, Co-Founder and AI Landman / Project Manager, at brian@nlrconservancy.com.

Key facts:
- Powered land = land with a realistic path to power at data center scale: near high-voltage transmission and a substation, with natural gas and long-haul fiber nearby.
- Every site is scored on a proprietary 120-point framework (transmission, substation topology, natural gas, fiber, zoning, ecological characteristics) and advanced through staged Tier I, II and III diligence.
- Target sites support 100 MW to gigawatt-scale deployments. Deal structures: ground lease, joint venture, equity participation or acquisition.
- Regions: Midwest, Plains, Southwest and Mid-Atlantic, plus strong projects nationwide.
- NLRC is not a contractor, broker or utility.
- Landowners can submit property for evaluation at no cost; NLRC bears due diligence costs and the landowner retains ownership during evaluation.
